name: book_light.fg
prompt: Create ONE transparent 16:9 foreground overlay at 1672x941 matching the supplied LIGHT ZONE background from Silent Hill Book of Memories. It is an independent parallax plane for the same side-view fighting stage. The supplied image is ONLY the background palette/material reference, do NOT reproduce it. Actual alpha-transparent canvas. Show only tiny near-camera fragments of its worn dark ochre stone pilasters clipped against the extreme left and extreme right canvas edges, each less than 5 percent of image width, stopping before the bottom 18 percent. Subtle irregular chipped edges and realistic material matching reference. The entire central 88 percent and the entire bottom 18 percent MUST be fully alpha transparent, no wash, dust, fog, glows, shadow rectangle or scene painted there. Do not draw floor, wall, windows, bench, any whole pillar, any character or symbols. Sparse edge trim only, one image, no grid, text or border. Keep all pixels outside these tiny side slivers transparent. No solid or checkered backdrop. Detailed raster texture, not vector shapes.
